cards.subject: The southern Black Morass
lines: Swamp. Water, trees, the same wet green as the Swamp of Sorrows next door — until Medivh opened the Portal and the marshes were twisted and dried up by the magic that brought it here.
The northern border is the seam where the damage stopped. Walk it and you cross from bog to red desert in about a minute.

cards.subject: There is one road in
cards.tag: And a keep on the shoulder of it
lines: Nethergarde stands on a high bluff along the only road into the Blasted Lands.
You come south out of the swamp or you do not come.
This is a corridor with a gate at the top of it.

cards.subject: Nethergarde is not a fort
lines: Primarily staffed by the Kirin Tor — mages, not soldiers, and about three hundred of them. Their job is to study what the Portal did to the soil and the wildlife.
Described as a dam holding back the evils of a blighted land, run by uptight perfectionists.
Its food comes by caravan from Stormwind because nothing grows here.

cards.subject: Who built the wall
lines: Khadgar ordered it after the Second War, funded by the kingdoms of the Alliance — and it was constructed by the Stonemasons Guild under the supervision of Edwin VanCleef.
The man the Alliance never paid built the thing holding back the demons.
You can kill him at eighteen and stand in his masonry at fifty.

cards.subject: Hot day, freezing night
lines: The mountains strip the moisture out of the air before it arrives.
Lightning strikes are constant.
The lightning near the Dark Portal is pure theatre — it cannot touch you.

cards.subject: What survived
lines: Few creatures live here beyond hardy desert species — basilisks, scorpids, vultures, boars.
Desert animals, in a place that was a swamp thirty years ago.
The only one with a name is a scorpid called Clack the Reaver.

cards.subject: The Tainted Scar
lines: "A completely waterless and treeless wasteland... barren soil the color of blood, teeming with strange and demonic beasts."
It was corrupted for years by the energies of the Portal — not by one event but by decades of leakage.
Kazzak sits in it.

cards.subject: The Altar of Storms
cards.tag: And the man living beside it
lines: The altar was raised by Lady Sevine, one of the Defiler's three immortals.
An elderly human warlock called Daio the Decrepit has simply moved in next to it, in a demon-held zone, to teach recruits.
Nobody stops him.

cards.subject: Three people who cannot be killed here
lines: Each wears a third of one amulet of Razelikh's making. "As long as they remained within the Blasted Lands, they couldn't be slain, their life spans extended until the end of days."
The whole chain exists because of that clause.
You are not killing them. You are dismantling a contract.

cards.subject: You need his real name
cards.tag: Razelikh is not what he is called
lines: To touch him you forge a weapon bearing the name Rakh'likh, with an ancient and a demon hunter.
He is immune to nearly everything a player brings — stuns, fear, banish, judgements, a warlock's whole book.
And he knocks people clean off the mountain. "Let the flames of chaos engulf you!"

cards.subject: Lord Kazzak eats your dead
lines: When any player, pet or totem dies, he instantly regenerates seventy thousand health.
Your hunter's pet and your shaman's totems are healing potions for him.
Three minutes in he berserks and it is over.

cards.subject: They walked him to Stormwind
lines: "Players initially kited him to Stormwind on various servers." A world boss dragged across a continent and let go in the trade district.
"This kiting is no longer possible as Lord Kazzak now will not travel beyond the Blasted Lands."
The leash on him is the scar tissue from that.

cards.subject: The Dark Portal
lines: In here it is dead scenery. Walk into it and you pass through to the back of the gate as if nothing were there.
Its glow is blue. It only turns green in the event before Burning Crusade.
No camps, no armies — the crater is ringed with elite demons and nothing else, and you creep up to it.
